description: Defines an internal interface ICommandInterceptor with a method Intercept that takes an IDbCommand parameter, used for intercepting database commands within the Orleans AdoNet storage modules under various contexts (clustering, persistence, reminders, streaming, grain directory, tests).

classes.name: ICommandInterceptor
classes.description: Internal interface for command interception, containing a single method to intercept database commands.

methods.name: Intercept
methods.description: Method to intercept and possibly modify or log a database command.
